raw.query: WITH rows AS (SELECT source_path, engine, image_px, n_images, mean_ms, ci95_ms, p50_ms, p99_ms, is_valid, note FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE source_path IN ('/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/fn_repro.json','/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/vllm_eager_dense.json') AND engine IN ('compiled','vllm') AND image_px=448 AND n_images=32), c AS (SELECT * FROM rows WHERE engine='compiled'), v AS (SELECT * FROM rows WHERE engine='vllm'), lifecycle AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name='is_current') AS has_is_current, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name='is_superseded') AS has_is_superseded, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name='_effective') AS has_effective, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name IN ('fold','window','window_name')) AS has_fold_or_window FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='provenance' AND table_name='collector_encoder_fn') SELECT c.source_path AS composed_source,v.source_path AS vllm_source,c.image_px,c.n_images,c.mean_ms AS composed_mean_ms,v.mean_ms AS vllm_denominator_mean_ms,(c.mean_ms-v.mean_ms) AS delta_ms,100.0*(c.mean_ms-v.mean_ms)/v.mean_ms AS pct_slower,c.ci95_ms AS composed_ci95_ms,v.ci95_ms AS vllm_ci95_ms,c.p50_ms AS composed_p50_ms,v.p50_ms AS vllm_p50_ms,c.p99_ms AS composed_p99_ms,v.p99_ms AS vllm_p99_ms,c.is_valid AS composed_valid,v.is_valid AS vllm_valid,c.note AS composed_note,v.note AS vllm_note,lifecycle.* FROM c CROSS JOIN v CROSS JOIN lifecycle
